purpose: Presents focused content in a modal surface entering from a screen edge.

notes: Provider language and direction are applied to the overlay and dialog.

useWhen: A task or decision requires focused interaction without leaving the page.

avoidWhen.situation: The content is brief contextual help anchored to a control.
The information can remain inline without interrupting the user.
avoidWhen.guidance: Keep it in page content or use an inline alert.

supportedInteractions: Trigger-managed or controlled opening, focus containment and return.
Escape, backdrop and native swipe dismissal when enabled.
Scrollable body with whole-dialog scrolling on constrained screens.
approvedPatterns: Compose Sheet.Header, Sheet.Title, Sheet.Description, Sheet.Body and Sheet.Footer inside Sheet; place dividers and Sheet.Close explicitly.
Supply a meaningful, nonempty Sheet.Title and short task content in Sheet.Body.
Put trigger-managed state on Sheet.Trigger; otherwise control Sheet itself.
Use Sheet.Handle for the optional mobile bottom-sheet grabber.
Use Sheet.Close or Veli Button slot="close" for an explicit dismissal action.
limitations: Requires React Aria Components 1.22 or later.
Side sheets retain a narrow backdrop rail.
No snap points, nested-sheet API, root forwarded ref or arbitrary root DOM prop pass-through. Layout parts accept DOM props and refs.
accessibility: A nonempty Sheet.Title is required and labels the dialog; Sheet.Description is automatically linked when mounted.
The labelled body region is keyboard-focusable for scrolling.
Include an explicit close action when preventing Escape, backdrop and swipe dismissal.
responsive: Width presets shrink to the available viewport.
Bottom height fits content or the viewport; side sheets fill viewport height.
Header, body and footer remain reachable in constrained layouts.
rtl: Logical start/end mirror with VeliProvider direction.
The visible close label is localized in Dhivehi.
